```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  "data/atus.duckdb",
  read_only = TRUE
)

hourly_avg <- dplyr::tbl(con, "atus") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    telfs == "Not in labor force",
    day_type == "Weekday",
    start_hour >= 6,
    start_hour <= 23,
    category %in% c(
      "Sleeping",
      "Personal Care",
      "Eating and Drinking",
      "Socializing and Leisure"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(start_hour, sex, category) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_minutes = mean(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(start_hour, sex, category) |>
  dplyr::collect()

print(hourly_avg)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  dplyr::filter(category != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = avg_minutes,
      y = forcats::fct_reorder(category, avg_minutes, .fun = mean),
      fill = sex
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Average Daily Time Spent by Activity",
    subtitle = "Mean minutes per day, grouped by sex",
    x = "Average daily minutes",
    y = "Activity category",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```
